youtube_spacing_rule: YouTube (via Buffer) allows 2 posts per ROLLING 24 h, and Buffer sends a few minutes late. Each YouTube post must be more than 24 h after the YouTube post two before it. Using only the 9 AM / 12 PM slots that gives the pattern 9+12, 12, 9, 9+12, 12, 9 ... (4 posts per 3 days). Example from 2026-11-27: 27th 9+12, 28th 12, 29th 9, 30th 9+12, Dec 1 12, Dec 2 9.

tag_priors._note: Starting guesses (0-100) for tags with fewer than 2 scored posts, from Nov 2026 short-form research: animal and comedy content gets the most views, spooky/creature stories do well for faceless story channels, surreal/abstract does worst. Measured tag scores replace these as data comes in.

trending.formula: 0.65*pct(views_per_hour) + 0.25*pct(like_rate) + 0.10*pct(share_rate), percentiles within platform, snapshot nearest 48 h after posting
